summary: End-to-end validation of the new admin 'Invite Professional' workflow (iter78 pro-invites). All 5 admin tabs render with correct testids; invite creation succeeds with success toast; duplicate invite blocked with 409 error toast; resend works. Invite-token prefills /auth?mode=register (name, email, ZIP) and credential-type-select is present; new professional registers, sees approval-pending-banner + credential-upload-section and successfully uploads a PDF into credential-file-list. Admin's Pending Credentials tab shows the pending-pro row with the uploaded pending-file link, ZIP 78209 chip, request-credentials-btn (success toast) and accept-pro-btn (row disappears, appears in Approved Professionals). ZIP filter on Approved Professionals correctly filters (78209 shows, 99999 hides). Backend security checks pass: GET /api/auth/pro-invite/<token> returns 404 after registration; non-admin POST /api/admin/pro-invites returns 403; other professional GET /api/credential-files/<fid> returns 404.
critical_code_review_comments: PendingCredentialActions has no state feedback on the Request-credentials button — the button remains enabled while awaiting the async call; consider disabling during in-flight (busy state).
CredentialUpload silently swallows any GET /me/credentials error (setData({files: []})). If the endpoint returns 500 the user sees an empty upload panel rather than an error state.

InviteProfessional list uses profile.zip startsWith for filtering but the admin list refresh after invite doesn't re-fetch pendingPros in Dashboard — verified data still fresh via full page reload; low priority.
